notes.title: v0.22a
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We've been working on several updates based on your feedback, and we're excited to share the latest improvements:

* Players who are kicked from a lobby will no longer be able to rejoin that lobby.
* To prevent issues caused by high ping, players with unstable connections will no longer be able to join lobbies.
* We've made some adjustments to the new lobby list, but further testing is still needed.
* Our bad word filtering system in the terminal has been enhanced for better moderation.
* Minor bugs have been fixed to enhance overall gameplay stability.
* Most importantly, if someone is disrupting your experience, please use the in-game reporting system to let us know.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: v0.20a
notes.content:
* From the lobby settings, you can choose whether the tablet can be used during the round. This way, you can prevent others from using your tablet.

* To improve gameplay experience at high pings, we've introduced measures to prevent excessive item acquisition. Your feedback on this is highly appreciated.

* New skins are now available for purchase with the in-game currency you've earned. Be sure to check them out!

* Minor bugs have been fixed to enhance overall gameplay stability.

notes.title: v0.17a
notes.content:
* Host could change while starting the game. This will no longer happen.

* Players were waiting unnecessarily due to inactive hosts. Now, if host is inactive in the waiting area, they will be removed from the lobby.

* Players were getting stuck while breaking boxes. Now you can cancel the animation by moving.

* Negative number input in the black market has been fixed.

* Syringe drop rate has been reduced.

* Speed in the Light Trap game has been increased.

* In the first minigame, only the reward game will appear to prevent anyone from dying.

* If the last 2 prisoners die at the same time, humanity wins.

* Some bugs in the trading system have been fixed.

* Some localization issues in Chinese have been resolved.

* Chat filtering has been improved.

* Various minor bugs have been fixed.

* Some sounds have been improved.

notes.title: v0.15a Patch Notes
notes.content:
* There were issues between round transitions when some players left the game. We tried to fix it, but it needs to be tested by players for a while.

* We've added a filter to help block bad words and hate speech.

* Now, every time you lock a door, you have to give 5 more tokens for the next lock.

* In Rapidfire, the winning player's tokens were sometimes sent to the wrong cell. Fixed.

* Some players' computers were experiencing errors when loading the menu scene. We've further optimized the loading process.

* The languages ​​you select when searching and creating a lobby will not be reset. They will remain as they were last selected.
